string.explorerscompass.name: Name
_comment.labeledValue: What stands between a label and its value. Languages that set their colon differently, or space it differently, change it here rather than anywhere in the code.
string.explorerscompass.searchSyntax.fie: Fields: id:, name:, mod: or @, group: or #, dim:
string.explorerscompass.searchSyntax.com: Use spaces for AND, - to exclude, and quotes for phrases.
string.explorerscompass.wrongDimension: The located structure is in a different dimension
string.explorerscompass.dimensionUnavail: The dimension the structure was located in is not available
string.explorerscompass.teleportOutOfBou: The located position lies outside the world border
string.explorerscompass.noSafeLanding: No safe place to land there
string.explorerscompass.clearFiltersHint: Clear a filter to see more
string.explorerscompass.listHint: ↑↓ and Enter to search · right click to star · Ctrl+click for several
string.explorerscompass.previewUnavailab: Nothing to show for this structure
It could not be assembled, or the server has previews switched off
string.explorerscompass.previewHint: Drag to turn · right drag to move · scroll to zoom · Shift+scroll or the slider to cut away · arrows, +/-, PgUp/PgDn · R to reset
string.explorerscompass.previewOutlineOn: None of it could be read, so only the shape of its pieces is shown
string.explorerscompass.previewTruncated: Too large to show in full
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.preview: Shows what the selected structure looks like.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.previewS: Structures only, and only once one is selected.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.previewM: Middle clicking a row does the same.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.resetVie: Puts the view back where it opened.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.autoSpin: Turns the structure slowly on its own.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.viewPres: Looks at the structure from the next of a few set angles.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.renderMo: Draws the structure as its blocks with their textures, or as flat colours.
Textures take a moment to build on a large structure; colours are instant.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.layerSli: Cuts the structure open from the top down, to look inside.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.lootMark: Marks every chest and loot container, even through walls. Point at one to see what it can hold.
string.explorerscompass.lootUnresolved: Its items could not be read
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.lootOver: Lists every loot table in this structure with everything it can hold. Clicking a chest marker on the model opens it too.
string.explorerscompass.lootTierFilterHi: Click to show only this tier, again to show all
string.explorerscompass.lootUnresolvedWa: Loot tables that could not be read: %s; the real chance may be higher
string.explorerscompass.lootViewContaine: Every loot table in the structure; %% is the chance in one container
string.explorerscompass.lootViewItems.to: Every item in the structure; %% is the chance to find at least one in the containers of this preview
_comment.lootTables: LOOT TABLE NAMES - the game names none of these itself
string.explorerscompass.noWaypoints: No waypoints in this world yet
string.explorerscompass.noWaypointsHint: Every place the compass locates is recorded here
string.explorerscompass.waypointOffHud: Not marked on the direction strip
string.explorerscompass.xaero.otherWorld: in a minimap world that is not open
string.explorerscompass.xaero.imported: made in the minimap, and read from there
string.explorerscompass.xaero.importedOt: made in a minimap world that is not open
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.waypoint: Lists the waypoints the compass has recorded in this world.
Every located place becomes one, is marked on the direction strip, and is mirrored into Xaero's Minimap where that is installed.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.pointAtW: Points the held compass at this waypoint.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.showOnHu: Marks this waypoint on the direction strip, or takes it off.
Right clicking a row does the same.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.removeWa: Forgets this waypoint, and takes it out of Xaero's Minimap.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.clearAll: Forgets every waypoint the compass found in this world, in the minimap too. Waypoints made in the minimap stay.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.xaeroDis: Where Xaero's Minimap draws its copies of these waypoints. The direction strip marks them either way.
World map only keeps them off the minimap and out of the world; Everywhere lets the minimap draw them like any waypoint; Hidden switches them off in the minimap.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.syncXaer: Puts every waypoint of this dimension the minimap has no copy of into it, and reads the minimap's own back: what was renamed, recoloured, moved or deleted there, and what was made there.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.settings: Settings for the compass, the HUD and the waypoints.
Also reached from the configure button in the mod list.
_comment.configuration: STRINGS - SETTINGS SCREEN. Every setting is named under explorerscompass.configuration.<setting>, with what it does under .tooltip, which is where the game's own configuration screen looks too.
explorerscompass.configuration.title: Settings
explorerscompass.configuration.tab.clien: How the compass looks and behaves on this computer: the HUD, the direction strip, the waypoints, the screens and the preview.
explorerscompass.configuration.tab.serve: The rules a server goes by: how hard it searches, what players may do, and what is kept off the list.
explorerscompass.configuration.hint: Click a value to change it · ↺ puts the default back · hover a row for what it does
explorerscompass.configuration.serverHin: Applies to the worlds this computer runs, and to everyone on them when one is opened to others.
This is this computer's copy. The server you are on goes by its own file, which only its owner can change.
Puts every setting shown back to its default.
explorerscompass.configuration.openFolde: Opens the folder the files live in, for editing them by hand.
explorerscompass.configuration.back.tool: Returns to where the settings were opened from. Every change has already been saved.
explorerscompass.configuration.notLoaded: These settings have not been loaded
explorerscompass.configuration.restartWo: Takes effect when the world is next opened
explorerscompass.configuration.restartGa: Takes effect when the game is next started
explorerscompass.configuration.invalid: Not a value this setting can take; it has not been applied
explorerscompass.configuration.list.hint: Type an entry and press return to add it. The cross on a row takes it out.
Adds what is typed in the field above the list.
explorerscompass.configuration.list.remo: Takes the selected entry out of the list.
explorerscompass.configuration.list.back: Returns to the settings. Every change has already been saved.
explorerscompass.configuration.structure: Structure ids. * matches any run of characters and ? matches one: minecraft:*village* covers every village.
explorerscompass.configuration.biomeBlac: Biome ids. * matches any run of characters and ? matches one: minecraft:*ocean* covers every ocean.
explorerscompass.configuration.allowTele: Lets players in creative mode, operators and players with cheats travel to the located place.
explorerscompass.configuration.teleportC: The least time between two teleports by the same player. Teleporting loads, and usually generates, the destination, so this keeps a modified client from queueing that up. 0 turns the cooldown off.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxNextSe: How many times a player may search past the located place for the next one before the collected places are forgotten and the search starts over. 0 always locates the nearest one.
explorerscompass.configuration.displayCo: Lets players read the exact coordinates and distance of the located place off the HUD, rather than only which way the compass points.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxRadius: How far out a search looks before giving up. Further finds more distant places at a higher cost.
explorerscompass.configuration.structure: Structures the compass neither lists nor searches for. * and ? work as wildcards.
explorerscompass.configuration.biomeBlac: Biomes the compass neither lists nor searches for. * and ? work as wildcards.
explorerscompass.configuration.hideStruc: Hide structures this world cannot generate
Leaves out the structures no dimension of this world could ever place, rather than offering them and having every search for one come back empty.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxSample: How many locations a structure search may look at before giving up.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxBiomeS: How many locations a biome search may look at before giving up. A biome can lie anywhere, so this is far more than a structure search needs, and each sample is far cheaper.
explorerscompass.configuration.biomeSamp: How many blocks apart the locations a biome search looks at are. Closer is less likely to step over a small biome; further covers the same ground in fewer samples.
explorerscompass.configuration.biomeVert: How many blocks apart the heights a biome search looks at are, which is what finds the biomes that fill the caves from the surface. 0 looks only at the height the search started at.
explorerscompass.configuration.biomeDept: Away from the starting height only every so many locations are looked at, since a cave biome covers far more ground than the spacing. 1 looks at every height everywhere.
explorerscompass.configuration.asyncBiom: Biome searches off the main thread
Runs biome searches on threads of their own, which finishes them several times sooner and costs the server nothing. Turn off if a biome mod turns out not to be safe to sample from another thread.
explorerscompass.configuration.asyncStru: Structure searches off the main thread

Works out where a structure would generate the way world generation does, on threads of their own, instead of asking chunk storage about every location. Turn off if a structure mod turns out not to be safe to generate from another thread.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxSearch: How much of each server tick searching on the main thread may take, shared by every search running. Lower keeps the game responsive; higher finishes sooner.
explorerscompass.configuration.searchReq: The least time between two searches by the same player. 0 turns the cooldown off.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxBookma: How many located places a compass remembers on itself, oldest forgotten first. 0 remembers none.
explorerscompass.configuration.allowShar: Lets players announce a located place to everyone on the server.
explorerscompass.configuration.shareCool: The least time between two announcements by the same player, so that sharing cannot flood the chat. 0 turns the cooldown off.
explorerscompass.configuration.allowStru: Lets players see what a structure looks like before searching for one. The server assembles it the way world generation would, off the main thread, and keeps the most recent ones.
explorerscompass.configuration.structure: How many cells across a preview may be. The default is large enough that no structure has to be shrunk to fit it.
How many cells of a preview may be sent. A structure whose surface does not fit is shrunk until it does, and is then no longer one cell to one block.
explorerscompass.configuration.displayWi: Keeps the compass HUD on screen while the chat is open.
explorerscompass.configuration.tooltipDe: How much the compass says about itself in its own tooltip. Compact keeps it to what it is doing, with the rest a held shift key away.
explorerscompass.configuration.translate: Uses the translated name of a structure where there is one, before tidying up its id.
Uses the translated name of a biome where there is one, before tidying up its id.
explorerscompass.configuration.createXae: Puts a copy of every waypoint the compass records into Xaero's Minimap, and keeps the two in step: a copy renamed, recoloured, moved or deleted there does the same here. Does nothing when that mod is not installed.
explorerscompass.configuration.importXae: Take in waypoints made in Xaero
Waypoints the player makes in Xaero's Minimap become waypoints of the compass too: marked on the strip, listed, and pointable at. Death markers and temporary waypoints are left alone.
explorerscompass.configuration.xaeroWayp: The colour new waypoints take on the direction strip and in the minimap, as a number from 0 to 15 in the game's list of text colours. 6 is gold.
Where Xaero's Minimap draws its copies. World map only keeps them off the minimap and out of the world, where the direction strip marks them already.
explorerscompass.configuration.maxWaypoi: How many waypoints one world or server keeps before the oldest are forgotten. 0 keeps them all.
explorerscompass.configuration.direction: Marks the waypoints of this dimension on the direction strip, with the name and distance of the one straight ahead read out under it.
How many of the nearest waypoints the strip marks at once.
The shape a waypoint is marked with on the strip and beside its name: a bookmark hanging from the top, a pin or a flag standing on the bottom, or a small diamond.
explorerscompass.configuration.showOverl: Keeps the HUD panel up while a compass is only carried rather than held.
explorerscompass.configuration.overlaySi: Which side of the screen the HUD panel is drawn on.
explorerscompass.configuration.overlayLi: How many lines down from the top of the screen the HUD panel starts.
explorerscompass.configuration.overlayBa: Draws the HUD on a panel of its own, which keeps it legible against a bright sky. Off leaves plain text.
explorerscompass.configuration.guiHeader: Fills in the strip along the top of the compass screens. Off leaves it outlined but see-through.
explorerscompass.configuration.guiSideba: Fills in the column of controls beside the list. Off leaves it outlined but see-through.
explorerscompass.configuration.guiStatus: Fills in the bar along the bottom of the structure screen. Off leaves it outlined but see-through.
explorerscompass.configuration.showDirec: Draws a strip of the horizon across the top of the screen, marking where the located place and the waypoints lie.
Keeps the direction strip up while a compass is only carried rather than held.
explorerscompass.configuration.direction: How far down from the top of the screen the strip is drawn.
How wide the strip is. Wider than the screen makes it span the whole screen.
How much of the horizon the strip covers. Less spreads the marks further apart; more keeps more in view at once.
Draws the strip on a panel of its own. Off leaves only the marks, which carry their own shadows.
explorerscompass.configuration.structure: Turns a structure preview slowly by itself. The button on the preview screen switches this too.
Marks chests and other loot containers on a structure preview, even through walls. The button on the preview screen switches this too.
Previews with more cells than this open drawn in flat colours rather than textures, which then build in the background. The button on the preview screen switches either way.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.searchTa: Switches between searching for structures and searching for biomes. Tab does the same.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.search: Searches for the nearest instance of the selected structure or biome.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.multiSel: Ctrl+click several rows to search for the nearest of them all.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.searchFo: Searches for the nearest member of the same group, whichever of them it turns out to be.
Searches past the located place for a further instance of it.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.clearCac: Forgets the locations already found, so that the search starts over from the closest one.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.stopSear: Stops the search and takes whatever the compass is aimed at back off it. Sneaking and right clicking the compass does the same.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.sortBy: Left click to change the order, right click to reverse it.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.dimensio: Hides whatever cannot generate in the dimension you are in.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.modFilte: Lists only what one mod adds. Clicking the badge on a row filters by that mod.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.bookmark: The places this compass has located, to point at or travel to again.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.share: Announces the located place to everyone on the server.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.pointAt: Points the compass at this location again.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.teleport: Travels to the located place. Only available where the server allows it.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.close: Closes this screen. The compass carries on with whatever it is doing.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.remove: Forgets this location. Searching for it again will find it again.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.clearAll: Forgets every location this compass has remembered.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.cannotGe: Cannot generate in the dimension you are in.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.usage.op: Right click to choose what to look for.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.usage.ca: Sneak and right click to clear the target.
string.explorerscompass.tooltip.notFound: Nothing was within the search radius. Travel further out and search again.
_comment.dimensions: STRINGS - DIMENSIONS. The game itself names no dimension, so without these every readout of one falls back to its id.
